summary: {person} recognizes the bus number but checks the map before counting on a familiar campus stop.
realLife: In March 2026 Milwaukee shortened Route 22 at its eastern end, taking its terminus back from the UW–Milwaukee campus to Humboldt Boulevard.
gates: A route keeps its number while its terminus changes.
weights: A route described simply as retained can conceal the loss of its terminal stops.
inGame: needs: route number, old and new termini, effective date and rider destination.

turns.what: The planner verifies the departure on the new schedule.
turns.pulledBy: The traveler’s stop is on the retained segment.
turns.writesBack: Keep the existing route in the trip plan.

turns.what: The planner searches for a connection from the new terminus.
turns.pulledBy: The traveler needs the lost segment.
turns.writesBack: Record the extra transfer or the uncovered destination.
